title: 第11章 小六乙丹第12章 炼丹
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“我还是叫你萧小姐吧。
关于我们之间的合作，萧小姐，你先看看丹方再说。”
叶云飞把丹方放在桌面上。
“快请黄老。”
萧楚楚对那店小二说道。
“是。”
店小二连忙答应。
片刻后。
一个须发半白，但是满面红光的老者，走了进来。
“黄老，这儿有一张丹方，想请你鉴别一下。”
萧楚楚说道，对这个老者十分恭敬。
“好的。”
黄老拿起桌面上的丹方，认真看了起来。
看着看着，很快，黄老的表情，就开始变得激动起来，眼中爆发出骇人的精芒，拿着丹方的一双手，也开始急剧颤抖了起来。
“妙，实在太妙了！”
黄老一边反复观看着丹方，一边推演着丹方中的药理，有一种喜极而泣的感觉。
“噫？”
萧楚楚见状，脸色变得凝重起来，终于，开始重视了。
叶云飞则是微微一笑。
要知道，叶云飞身为丹尊，精通炼药，所掌握的丹方，哪一种，不是惊天动地，属于稀世珍宝呢。

可以毫不夸张地说，叶云飞只要随随便便拿出来，自己所掌握的，最差最差的一种丹方，就足够完爆灵珍坊所有珍藏的丹方！
“黄老，怎么样？”
萧楚楚问道。
“坊主，这种丹方，是我这一生中，所见过的，药理搭配最高明，最神奇的丹方。
我一生中精研药理，这一张丹方中的各种灵药搭配，君臣佐使，是我从来想也不敢想的，可是，偏偏又妙到巅峰，妙不可言啊！
刚才观看这一张丹方，使我的药理水平，直接就提升了一大截！
而且，这种灵丹，可以提纯武者体内的灵气，使武者的根基变得更加扎实，拥有这种药效的灵丹，市面上，少之又少。
坊主，这张丹方，是稀世之宝，无论花费多大的代价，也一定要把它买下来！”
黄老说道。
“这么厉害！”
萧楚楚终于意识到，那张丹方的价值所在了。
她和叶云飞合作，初衷是希望叶云飞能帮她解决身体上的问题。
至于叶云飞所说的合作开发丹方，她一点也不重视。
一个小家族的少爷，能拿得出来什么有价值的丹方呢，可能性太低了。
但是，她想不到，叶云飞所提供的丹方，价值竟然如此之高，这真是意外之喜。
她丝毫不怀疑黄老的目光。
黄老精通药理，擅长炼丹，在灵珍坊之中，属于元老级别的存在。
所以，她才特意把黄老，从总部抽调来圆月城，帮自己的忙。
“这种小六乙丹，不但可以提纯武者体内的灵气，而且，可以清除一切的丹毒。
不管体内积累了多少的丹毒，只要服下小六乙丹，就可以立即清除掉，而且，是清除得十分彻底，干干净净。”
content_en:
"I'd better call you Miss Xiao.
Regarding our cooperation, Miss Xiao, please take a look at the prescription first. "
Ye Yunfei put the prescription on the table.
"Please invite Mr. Huang quickly."
Xiao Chuchu said to the waiter in the shop.
"Yes."
The waiter agreed quickly.
After a while.
An old man with half-white beard and hair but a red face walked in.
"Mr. Huang, there is a prescription for elixir here. I would like you to identify it."
Xiao Chuchu said, very respectful to this old man.
"Okay."
Mr. Huang picked up the prescription on the table and looked at it carefully.
As he watched, Huang Lao's expression soon began to become excited, his eyes burst into frightening light, and the hands holding the pill began to tremble sharply.
"Wonderful, so wonderful!"
Mr. Huang repeatedly watched the prescription and deduced its medicinal properties, feeling like he was crying with joy.
"Huh?"
Seeing this, Xiao Chuchu's face became solemn, and finally she began to pay attention.
Ye Yunfei smiled slightly.
You must know that Ye Yunfei is an alchemy master and is proficient in refining medicine. Which of the elixir recipes he masters is not earth-shattering and a rare treasure.
It is no exaggeration to say that as long as Ye Yunfei takes it out casually, the worst and worst elixir he has is enough to destroy all the elixirs in Lingzhenfang's collection!
"Old Huang, how are you?"
Xiao Chuchu asked.
"Master, this elixir is the most brilliant and magical elixir with the most brilliant pharmacological combination that I have ever seen in my life.
I have studied pharmacology intensively in my life, and the combination of various elixirs in this elixir, and the combination of monarchs, ministers, and envoys are something I have never dared to imagine. However, it is so wonderful that it is so wonderful that it is beyond words!
Just watching this elixir recipe has directly improved my pharmacological level a lot!
Moreover, this kind of elixir can purify the spiritual energy in a warrior's body and make the warrior's foundation more solid. There are very few elixirs with this kind of medicinal effect on the market.
Boss, this elixir recipe is a rare treasure. No matter how much it costs, you must buy it! "
Huang Lao said.
"So awesome!"
Xiao Chuchu finally realized the value of that pill prescription.
Her original intention in cooperating with Ye Yunfei was that he could help her solve her physical problems.
As for what Ye Yunfei said about cooperating in the development of elixirs, she didn't pay attention at all.
The possibility that a young master from a small family could come up with any valuable prescriptions was too low.
However, she did not expect that the value of the elixir provided by Ye Yunfei would be so high, which was a real surprise.
She didn't doubt Mr. Huang's gaze at all.
Huang Lao is proficient in pharmacology and good at alchemy. He is a veteran-level existence in Lingzhenfang.
That's why she specially transferred Mr. Huang from the headquarters to Yuanyue City to help her.
"This Xiao Liuyi Pill can not only purify the spiritual energy in a warrior's body, but also remove all erysipelas.
No matter how much erysipelas has accumulated in the body, as long as you take Xiaoliuyi Dan, it can be removed immediately, and it will be removed very thoroughly and cleanly. "
